```python
    O = bot
```

```python
def dsl2(I):
    dims = multiply(THREE_BY_THREE, THREE)
    steps = interval(ZERO, multiply(THREE, THREE), THREE)
    roffs = apply(toivec, steps)
    coffs = apply(tojvec, steps)
    blockoffsets = prapply(add, roffs, coffs)
    baseobj = asobject(I)
    tiledobj = mapply(lbind(shift, baseobj), blockoffsets)
    tiled = paint(canvas(ZERO, dims), tiledobj)
    nzidx = difference(asindices(I), ofcolor(I, ZERO))
    p3 = apply(rbind(multiply, THREE), nzidx)
    base = asindices(I)
    mask = mapply(lbind(shift, base), p3)
    colored = toobject(mask, tiled)
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, dims), colored)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    nzidx = difference(asindices(I), ofcolor(I, ZERO))
    p3 = apply(rbind(multiply, THREE), nzidx)
    cells = toobject(nzidx, I)

    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, multiply(THREE_BY_THREE, THREE)), uobj)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    A = replace(I, ONE, TWO)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    Top = crop(A, ORIGIN, astuple(THREE, W))
    S1 = toivec(decrement(halve(H)))
    S2 = toivec(halve(H))
    Mid1 = crop(A, S1, astuple(THREE, W))
    Mid2 = crop(A, S2, astuple(THREE, W))
    Xtop = ofcolor(Top, TWO)
    X1 = ofcolor(Mid1, TWO)
    X2 = ofcolor(Mid2, TWO)
    I1 = size(intersection(X1, Xtop))
    I2 = size(intersection(X2, Xtop))
    B = branch(greater(I1, I2), Mid1, Mid2)
    O = vconcat(A, B)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    samecolor = compose(lbind(colorfilter, objs), color)
    rmap = lbind(apply, rightmost)
    maxright_in_color = compose(maximum, rmap)
    Rc = compose(maxright_in_color, samecolor)
    is_blocked = fork(equality, rightmost, Rc)
    blocked = sfilter(objs, is_blocked)
    allowed = difference(objs, blocked)
    shifted = apply(rbind(shift, RIGHT), allowed)
    merged = merge(combine(shifted, blocked))
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), merged)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl2(I):
    A = objects(I, T, F, T)
    LM = compose(leftmost, toindices)
    AO = order(A, LM)
    O1 = first(AO)
    AO2 = remove(O1, AO)
    O2 = first(AO2)
    AO3 = remove(O2, AO2)
    O3 = first(AO3)
    I1 = toindices(O1)
    I2 = toindices(O2)
    I3 = toindices(O3)
    h1 = height(I1)
    w1 = width(I1)
    h2 = height(I2)
    w2 = width(I2)
    h3 = height(I3)
    w3 = width(I3)
    Hsum = subtract(add(add(h1, h2), h3), TWO)
    Wsum = subtract(add(add(w1, w2), w3), TWO)
    ul1 = ulcorner(I1)
    lr1 = lrcorner(I1)
    ul2 = ulcorner(I2)
    ul3 = ulcorner(I3)
    s2 = subtract(lrcorner(I2), ulcorner(I2))
    lrAB = add(lr1, s2)
    P1 = shift(I1, invert(ul1))
    P2 = shift(I2, subtract(lr1, ul2))
    P3 = shift(I3, subtract(lrAB, ul3))
    Q1 = recolor(color(O1), P1)
    Q2 = recolor(color(O2), P2)
    Q3 = recolor(color(O3), P3)
    S0 = initset(Q1)
    S1 = insert(Q2, S0)
    S2 = insert(Q3, S1)
    U = merge(S2)
    Z = canvas(ZERO, astuple(Hsum, Wsum))
    G = paint(Z, U)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    Zb = canvas(ZERO, astuple(subtract(H, Hsum), Wsum))
    T = vconcat(G, Zb)
    Zr = canvas(ZERO, astuple(H, subtract(W, Wsum)))
    O = hconcat(T, Zr)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    A = objects(I, T, F, T)
    CA = compose(size, toindices)
    AO = order(A, CA)
    Oa = first(AO)
    AO2 = remove(Oa, AO)
    Ob = first(AO2)
    AO3 = remove(Ob, AO2)
    Oc = first(AO3)
    Ia = toindices(Oa)
    Ib = toindices(Ob)
    Ic = toindices(Oc)
    ha = height(Ia)
    hb = height(Ib)
    hc = height(Ic)
    wa = width(Ia)
    wb = width(Ib)
    wc = width(Ic)
    ula = ulcorner(Ia)
    ulb = ulcorner(Ib)
    ulc = ulcorner(Ic)
    P1 = shift(Ia, invert(ula))
    off2 = add(tojvec(wa), invert(ulb))
    P2 = shift(Ib, off2)
    off3 = add(tojvec(add(wa, wb)), invert(ulc))
    P3 = shift(Ic, off3)
    Q1 = recolor(color(Oa), P1)
    Q2 = recolor(color(Ob), P2)
    Q3 = recolor(color(Oc), P3)
    U = merge(insert(Q3, insert(Q2, initset(Q1))))
    Hset = insert(ha, insert(hb, initset(hc)))
    Hmax = maximum(Hset)
    Wsum = add(add(wa, wb), wc)
    Z = canvas(ZERO, astuple(Hmax, Wsum))
    G = paint(Z, U)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    Zb = canvas(ZERO, astuple(subtract(H, Hmax), Wsum))
    V = vconcat(G, Zb)
    Zr = canvas(ZERO, astuple(H, subtract(W, Wsum)))
    O = hconcat(V, Zr)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl2(I):
    # Geometric replication of object frames in a 3x3 grid using object size as step
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    frame = fork(recolor, color, compose(box, toindices))
    wv = compose(tojvec, width)
    hv = compose(toivec, height)
    nwv = compose(invert, wv)
    nhv = compose(invert, hv)
    base = apply(frame, objs)
    r = apply(fork(shift, frame, wv), objs)
    l = apply(fork(shift, frame, nwv), objs)
    d = apply(fork(shift, frame, hv), objs)
    u = apply(fork(shift, frame, nhv), objs)
    rd = apply(fork(shift, frame, fork(add, wv, hv)), objs)
    ru = apply(fork(shift, frame, fork(add, wv, nhv)), objs)
    ld = apply(fork(shift, frame, fork(add, nwv, hv)), objs)
    lu = apply(fork(shift, frame, fork(add, nwv, nhv)), objs)
    allsets = combine(combine(combine(combine(base, r), combine(l, d)),
                              combine(u, combine(rd, ru))),
                      combine(ld, lu))
    allcells = merge(allsets)
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), allcells)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl2(I):
    # Geometric reasoning: replicate each object on a 3x3 lattice using the largest object's size as step
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    big = argmax(objs, compose(size, toindices))
    bidx = toindices(big)
    stepw = tojvec(width(bidx))
    stepv = toivec(height(bidx))
    nstepw = invert(stepw)
    nstepv = invert(stepv)
    rdv = add(stepw, stepv)
    ruv = add(stepw, nstepv)
    ldv = add(nstepw, stepv)
    luv = add(nstepw, nstepv)
    base = toindices
    rs = compose(rbind(shift, stepw), toindices)
    ls = compose(rbind(shift, nstepw), toindices)
    ds = compose(rbind(shift, stepv), toindices)
    us = compose(rbind(shift, nstepv), toindices)
    rd = compose(rbind(shift, rdv), toindices)
    ru = compose(rbind(shift, ruv), toindices)
    ld = compose(rbind(shift, ldv), toindices)
    lu = compose(rbind(shift, luv), toindices)
    funcs = insert(base, insert(rs, insert(ls, insert(ds, insert(us, insert(rd, insert(ru, insert(ld, initset(lu)))))))))
    per = compose(merge, lbind(rapply, funcs))
    stamps = apply(fork(recolor, color, per), objs)
    allcells = merge(stamps)
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), allcells)
    return O
```

```python
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), merge(stamps))
```

```python
    ones = ofcolor(I, ONE)

    Rones_global = intersection(ones, Rbox)
    align_vec = invert(right_start)
    Raligned = shift(Rones_global, align_vec)
    P = intersection(Lones, Raligned)
    O = fill(canvas(ZERO, dims), TWO, P)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    NZ = difference(asindices(I), ofcolor(I, ZERO))
    PARTS = fgpartition(I)
    COLORS = colorfilter(PARTS, ZERO)
    NONZ = remove(ofcolor(I, ZERO), PARTS)
    # anchor per color at its uppermost occurrence via cropping its subgrid top row
    ANCH = NONZ
    S_UP = compose(rbind(shoot, UP_RIGHT), compose(first, toindices))
    S_DL = compose(rbind(shoot, DOWN_LEFT), compose(first, toindices))
    LINES = apply(fork(recolor, color, fork(combine, S_UP, S_DL)), ANCH)
    BIG = merge(LINES)
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), BIG)
    return O
```

```python
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    two = first(colorfilter(objs, TWO))
    eight = first(colorfilter(objs, EIGHT))

    base = cover(I, two)

    moved = recolor(TWO, shifted)
    O = paint(base, moved)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl3(I):
    # Relational (axis selection via overlap + manhattan magnitude)
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    two = first(colorfilter(objs, TWO))
    eight = first(colorfilter(objs, EIGHT))
    axis = branch(vmatching(two, eight), toivec(ONE), tojvec(ONE))
    dirv = sign(position(two, eight))

    off = mpapply(multiply, stepvec, axis)
    base = cover(I, two)
    shifted = shift(toindices(two), off)
    moved = recolor(TWO, shifted)
    O = paint(base, moved)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Global geometric transform (rotate, solve by edges, rotate back)
    R = rot90(I)
    ro = objects(R, T, F, T)
    rtwo = first(colorfilter(ro, TWO))
    reight = first(colorfilter(ro, EIGHT))
    rh = tojvec(decrement(subtract(leftmost(reight), rightmost(rtwo))))
    rv = toivec(decrement(subtract(uppermost(reight), lowermost(rtwo))))
    roff = branch(hmatching(rtwo, reight), rh, rv)
    rbase = cover(R, rtwo)
    rshift = shift(toindices(rtwo), roff)
    rnew = recolor(TWO, rshift)
    OR = paint(rbase, rnew)
    O = rot270(OR)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    lc = mostcolor(I)
    allobs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    nonline = difference(allobs, colorfilter(allobs, lc))
    cells = sizefilter(nonline, 4)
    pp = product(cells, cells)
    same = fork(equality, compose(color, first), compose(color, last))
    samerow = fork(equality, compose(uppermost, first), compose(uppermost, last))
    samecol = fork(equality, compose(leftmost, first), compose(leftmost, last))
    hpairs = sfilter(pp, fork(both, same, samerow))
    vpairs = sfilter(pp, fork(both, same, samecol))
    hrects = mapply(compose(backdrop, fork(combine, first, last)), hpairs)
    vrects = mapply(compose(backdrop, fork(combine, first, last)), vpairs)
    hcol = mapply(fork(recolor, compose(color, first), compose(backdrop, fork(combine, first, last))), hpairs)
    vcol = mapply(fork(recolor, compose(color, first), compose(backdrop, fork(combine, first, last))), vpairs)
    toadd = merge(combine(hcol, vcol))
    O = underpaint(I, toadd)
    return O
```

```python
    # Geometric bridging using centers and connection lines plus rectangular fill
    lc = mostcolor(I)
    obs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    seeds = sizefilter(difference(obs, colorfilter(obs, lc)), 4)
    prs = product(seeds, seeds)

    samer = fork(equality, compose(uppermost, first), compose(uppermost, last))

    hp = sfilter(prs, fork(both, samec, samer))

    add = combine(combine(hcore, vcore), combine(hfill, vfill))
    O = underpaint(I, add)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Color-structured alignment: overlap matching with interior fill (inbox) in both axes
    lc = mostcolor(I)
    obs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    seeds = sizefilter(difference(obs, colorfilter(obs, lc)), 4)
    prs = product(seeds, seeds)
    samec = fork(equality, compose(color, first), compose(color, last))
    hmat = fork(hmatching, first, last)
    vmat = fork(vmatching, first, last)
    hp = sfilter(prs, fork(both, samec, hmat))
    vp = sfilter(prs, fork(both, samec, vmat))
    hin = mapply(fork(recolor, compose(color, first), compose(inbox, fork(combine, first, last))), hp)
    vin = mapply(fork(recolor, compose(color, first), compose(inbox, fork(combine, first, last))), vp)
    add = combine(hin, vin)
    O = underpaint(I, add)
```

```python
def dsl2(I):
    G = replace(I, EIGHT, ZERO)
    C = compress(G)
    Oset = objects(C, T, F, T)
    O2s = colorfilter(Oset, TWO)
    O3s = colorfilter(Oset, THREE)
    O4s = colorfilter(Oset, FOUR)
    O6s = colorfilter(Oset, SIX)
    L2 = argmax(O2s, size)
    L3 = argmax(O3s, size)
    L4 = argmax(O4s, size)
    L6 = argmax(O6s, size)
    TT = astuple(THREE, THREE)
    P2 = multiply(divide(centerofmass(L2), TT), TT)
    P3 = multiply(divide(centerofmass(L3), TT), TT)
    P4 = multiply(divide(centerofmass(L4), TT), TT)
    P6 = multiply(divide(centerofmass(L6), TT), TT)
    B = asindices(canvas(ZERO, TT))
    Q2 = recolor(TWO, shift(B, P2))
    Q3 = recolor(THREE, shift(B, P3))
    Q4 = recolor(FOUR, shift(B, P4))
    Q6 = recolor(SIX, shift(B, P6))
    ALL = combine(combine(Q2, Q3), combine(Q4, Q6))
    A = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(C)), ALL)
    UL = crop(A, astuple(ZERO, ZERO), astuple(THREE, THREE))
    UM = crop(A, astuple(ZERO, THREE), astuple(THREE, THREE))
    UR = crop(A, astuple(ZERO, SIX), astuple(THREE, THREE))
    ML = crop(A, astuple(THREE, ZERO), astuple(THREE, THREE))
    MM = crop(A, astuple(THREE, THREE), astuple(THREE, THREE))
    MR = crop(A, astuple(THREE, SIX), astuple(THREE, THREE))
    BL = crop(A, astuple(SIX, ZERO), astuple(THREE, THREE))
    BM = crop(A, astuple(SIX, THREE), astuple(THREE, THREE))
    BR = crop(A, astuple(SIX, SIX), astuple(THREE, THREE))
    VBAR = canvas(FIVE, astuple(THREE, ONE))
    R1 = hconcat(hconcat(UL, VBAR), hconcat(UM, hconcat(VBAR, UR)))
    R2 = hconcat(hconcat(ML, VBAR), hconcat(MM, hconcat(VBAR, MR)))
    R3 = hconcat(hconcat(BL, VBAR), hconcat(BM, hconcat(VBAR, BR)))
    W2 = width(R1)
    HBAR = canvas(FIVE, astuple(ONE, W2))
    O = vconcat(vconcat(R1, HBAR), vconcat(R2, vconcat(HBAR, R3)))
    return O
```

```python
    c = leastcolor(I)
    centers = ofcolor(I, c)
    nb = remove(ZERO, palette(I))

    n1 = mapply(neighbors, centers)
    d1 = mapply(ineighbors, centers)

    n2 = mapply(neighbors, r1)

    O = fill(O, arm, plus)
    O = fill(O, c, diag)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    # Geometric (directional shifts): build plus and diagonals by shifting centers by step 1 and 2
    pal = palette(I)
    c = leastcolor(I)
    a = other(remove(ZERO, pal), c)
    centers = ofcolor(I, c)
    plus1 = combine(shift(centers, RIGHT), shift(centers, LEFT))
    plus2 = combine(shift(centers, UP), shift(centers, DOWN))
    plus3 = combine(shift(centers, double(RIGHT)), shift(centers, double(LEFT)))
    plus4 = combine(shift(centers, double(UP)), shift(centers, double(DOWN)))
    plus = combine(combine(centers, combine(plus1, plus2)), combine(plus3, plus4))
    diag1 = combine(shift(centers, UNITY), shift(centers, NEG_UNITY))
    diag2 = combine(shift(centers, UP_RIGHT), shift(centers, DOWN_LEFT))
    diag3 = combine(shift(centers, double(UNITY)), shift(centers, double(NEG_UNITY)))
    diag4 = combine(shift(centers, double(UP_RIGHT)), shift(centers, double(DOWN_LEFT)))
    diag = combine(combine(centers, combine(diag1, diag2)), combine(diag3, diag4))
    O = canvas(ZERO, shape(I))
    O = fill(O, a, plus)
    O = fill(O, c, diag)
    return O
```

```python
    # Object extraction: per-center local mask via expansion, lines via frontiers/shoot, layered with paint

    centers = mapply(toindices, cobjs)
    n1 = mapply(neighbors, centers)
    d1 = mapply(ineighbors, centers)
    r1 = combine(combine(centers, n1), d1)
    n2 = mapply(neighbors, r1)
    d2 = mapply(ineighbors, r1)
    mask = combine(combine(r1, n2), d2)
    h = mapply(hfrontier, centers)
    v = mapply(vfrontier, centers)
    plus = intersection(combine(h, v), mask)

    diag = intersection(combine(prapply(shoot, centers, dirs1), prapply(shoot, centers, dirs2)), mask)
    O = canvas(ZERO, shape(I))
    O = paint(O, recolor(a, plus))
    O = paint(O, recolor(c, diag))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    # Global coarse summary: per 10x10 tile, vote among central 8x8, center row, and center col, then crop zero-only rows/cols
    z = ZERO; o = ONE; t = TEN; tt = double(TEN)
    U = UNITY
    d8 = astuple(EIGHT, EIGHT)
    drow = astuple(ONE, TEN)
    dcol = astuple(TEN, ONE)
    # starts per tile
    r0 = z; r1 = t; r2 = tt
    c0 = z; c1 = t; c2 = tt
    # central 8x8 starts
    s00 = astuple(add(r0,o), add(c0,o)); s01 = astuple(add(r0,o), add(c1,o)); s02 = astuple(add(r0,o), add(c2,o))
    s10 = astuple(add(r1,o), add(c0,o)); s11 = astuple(add(r1,o), add(c1,o)); s12 = astuple(add(r1,o), add(c2,o))
    s20 = astuple(add(r2,o), add(c0,o)); s21 = astuple(add(r2,o), add(c1,o)); s22 = astuple(add(r2,o), add(c2,o))
    # center row starts
    rr00 = astuple(add(r0,FIVE), c0); rr01 = astuple(add(r0,FIVE), c1); rr02 = astuple(add(r0,FIVE), c2)
    rr10 = astuple(add(r1,FIVE), c0); rr11 = astuple(add(r1,FIVE), c1); rr12 = astuple(add(r1,FIVE), c2)
    rr20 = astuple(add(r2,FIVE), c0); rr21 = astuple(add(r2,FIVE), c1); rr22 = astuple(add(r2,FIVE), c2)
    # center col starts
    cc00 = astuple(r0, add(c0,FIVE)); cc01 = astuple(r0, add(c1,FIVE)); cc02 = astuple(r0, add(c2,FIVE))
    cc10 = astuple(r1, add(c0,FIVE)); cc11 = astuple(r1, add(c1,FIVE)); cc12 = astuple(r1, add(c2,FIVE))
    cc20 = astuple(r2, add(c0,FIVE)); cc21 = astuple(r2, add(c1,FIVE)); cc22 = astuple(r2, add(c2,FIVE))
    # votes per tile (mode of three samples)
    def vote(s, sr, sc):
        c8 = mostcolor(crop(I, s, d8))
        cr = mostcolor(crop(I, sr, drow))
        cc = mostcolor(crop(I, sc, dcol))
        row = hconcat(canvas(c8,U), hconcat(canvas(cr,U), canvas(cc,U)))
        return mostcolor(row)
    v00 = vote(s00, rr00, cc00); v01 = vote(s01, rr01, cc01); v02 = vote(s02, rr02, cc02)
    v10 = vote(s10, rr10, cc10); v11 = vote(s11, rr11, cc11); v12 = vote(s12, rr12, cc12)
    v20 = vote(s20, rr20, cc20); v21 = vote(s21, rr21, cc21); v22 = vote(s22, rr22, cc22)
    # assemble and crop zero-only margins
    rA = hconcat(canvas(v00,U), hconcat(canvas(v01,U), canvas(v02,U)))
    rB = hconcat(canvas(v10,U), hconcat(canvas(v11,U), canvas(v12,U)))
    rC = hconcat(canvas(v20,U), hconcat(canvas(v21,U), canvas(v22,U)))
    G = vconcat(rA, vconcat(rB, rC))
    nz = difference(asindices(G), ofcolor(G, ZERO))
    O = subgrid(nz, G)
    return O
```

```python
    # Color filtering via morphology: remove single-pixel noise, keep larger objects, then downscale and crop zero-only margins

    OB = objects(I, T, F, T)
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    # Geometric sampling per tile: 5-point cross vote around tile center
    z = ZERO; t = TEN; tt = double(TEN); U = UNITY
    # centers

    c0 = add(z, FIVE); c1 = add(t, FIVE); c2 = add(tt, FIVE)

    def vote5(r,c):

        row2 = hconcat(canvas(e,U), canvas(f,U))
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational/structural: per tile, choose the object closest to the tile's center cross (argmin manhattan), use its color
    z = ZERO; t = TEN; tt = double(TEN); U = UNITY
    d10 = astuple(TEN, TEN)
    # tiles and center-cross patches
    def tile_and_cross(r0, c0):
        T = crop(I, astuple(r0,c0), d10)
        cr = add(r0, FIVE); cc = add(c0, FIVE)
        p = astuple(cr, cc)
        up = shoot(p, UP); dn = shoot(p, DOWN); lf = shoot(p, LEFT); rt = shoot(p, RIGHT)
        cross = merge(initset(up) | initset(dn) | initset(lf) | initset(rt))
        return T, cross
    T00, X00 = tile_and_cross(z, z); T01, X01 = tile_and_cross(z, t); T02, X02 = tile_and_cross(z, tt)
    T10, X10 = tile_and_cross(t, z); T11, X11 = tile_and_cross(t, t); T12, X12 = tile_and_cross(t, tt)
    T20, X20 = tile_and_cross(tt, z); T21, X21 = tile_and_cross(tt, t); T22, X22 = tile_and_cross(tt, tt)
    # nearest-to-cross object color per tile
    def nearcol(T, X):
        OB = objects(T, T, F, T)
        dfunc = rbind(manhattan, X)
        Osel = argmin(OB, dfunc)
        return color(Osel)
    c00 = nearcol(T00, X00); c01 = nearcol(T01, X01); c02 = nearcol(T02, X02)
    c10 = nearcol(T10, X10); c11 = nearcol(T11, X11); c12 = nearcol(T12, X12)
    c20 = nearcol(T20, X20); c21 = nearcol(T21, X21); c22 = nearcol(T22, X22)
    r0 = hconcat(canvas(c00,U), hconcat(canvas(c01,U), canvas(c02,U)))
    r1 = hconcat(canvas(c10,U), hconcat(canvas(c11,U), canvas(c12,U)))
    r2 = hconcat(canvas(c20,U), hconcat(canvas(c21,U), canvas(c22,U)))
    O = vconcat(r0, vconcat(r1, r2))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    z = ZERO; t = TEN; tt = double(TEN); U = UNITY
    r0 = add(z, FIVE); r1 = add(t, FIVE); r2 = add(tt, FIVE)
    c0 = add(z, FIVE); c1 = add(t, FIVE); c2 = add(tt, FIVE)
    def sample_color(r, c):
        pt = initset(astuple(r, c))
        return color(toobject(pt, I))
    def vote5(r, c):
        a = sample_color(r, c)
        b = sample_color(decrement(r), c)
        d = sample_color(increment(r), c)
        e = sample_color(r, decrement(c))
        f = sample_color(r, increment(c))
        row = hconcat(canvas(a,U), hconcat(canvas(b,U), canvas(d,U)))
        row2 = hconcat(canvas(e,U), canvas(f,U))
        mix = hconcat(row, row2)
        return mostcolor(mix)
    c00 = vote5(r0,c0); c01 = vote5(r0,c1); c02 = vote5(r0,c2)
    c10 = vote5(r1,c0); c11 = vote5(r1,c1); c12 = vote5(r1,c2)
    c20 = vote5(r2,c0); c21 = vote5(r2,c1); c22 = vote5(r2,c2)
    rA = hconcat(canvas(c00,U), hconcat(canvas(c01,U), canvas(c02,U)))
    rB = hconcat(canvas(c10,U), hconcat(canvas(c11,U), canvas(c12,U)))
    rC = hconcat(canvas(c20,U), hconcat(canvas(c21,U), canvas(c22,U)))
    G = vconcat(rA, vconcat(rB, rC))
    nz = difference(asindices(G), ofcolor(G, ZERO))
    O = subgrid(nz, G)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    # Geometric: 3x3 neighborhood vote around tile center
    z = ZERO; t = TEN; tt = double(TEN); U = UNITY
    d10 = astuple(TEN, TEN)
    def sample(T, p):
        return color(toobject(initset(p), T))
    def vote9(r0, c0):
        T = crop(I, astuple(r0, c0), d10)
        p = astuple(FIVE, FIVE)
        a = sample(T, p)
        b = sample(T, add(p, UP))
        c = sample(T, add(p, DOWN))
        d = sample(T, add(p, LEFT))
        e = sample(T, add(p, RIGHT))
        f = sample(T, add(p, UP_RIGHT))
        g = sample(T, add(p, UP_LEFT))
        h = sample(T, add(p, DOWN_RIGHT))
        i = sample(T, add(p, DOWN_LEFT))
        rA = hconcat(canvas(g,U), hconcat(canvas(b,U), canvas(f,U)))
        rB = hconcat(canvas(d,U), hconcat(canvas(a,U), canvas(e,U)))
        rC = hconcat(canvas(i,U), hconcat(canvas(c,U), canvas(h,U)))
        mix = vconcat(rA, vconcat(rB, rC))
        return mostcolor(mix)
    c00 = vote9(z, z);   c01 = vote9(z, t);   c02 = vote9(z, tt)
    c10 = vote9(t, z);   c11 = vote9(t, t);   c12 = vote9(t, tt)
```

```python
    # Object extraction: choose object with maximum overlap with central 8x8 window in each tile
    z = ZERO; t = TEN; tt = double(TEN); U = UNITY
    d10 = astuple(TEN, TEN); off = astuple(ONE, ONE); d8 = astuple(EIGHT, EIGHT)
    def max_overlap_center8(r0, c0):

        OB = objects(T, T, F, T)
        comp = chain(size, lbind(intersection, X), toindices)
        B = argmax(OB, comp)
        return color(B)
    c00 = max_overlap_center8(z, z);   c01 = max_overlap_center8(z, t);   c02 = max_overlap_center8(z, tt)

    c20 = max_overlap_center8(tt, z);  c21 = max_overlap_center8(tt, t);  c22 = max_overlap_center8(tt, tt)

    r1 = hconcat(canvas(c10,U), hconcat(canvas(c11,U), canvas(c12,U)))
```

```python
def dsl3(I):
    # Color filtering: intersect colors from center cross and inner 8x8; fallback to inner if empty
    z = ZERO; t = TEN; tt = double(TEN); U = UNITY
    d10 = astuple(TEN, TEN); off = astuple(ONE, ONE); d8 = astuple(EIGHT, EIGHT)
    def cross_inner_mode(r0, c0):
        T = crop(I, astuple(r0, c0), d10)
        p = astuple(FIVE, FIVE)
        up = shoot(p, UP); dn = shoot(p, DOWN); lf = shoot(p, LEFT); rt = shoot(p, RIGHT)
        X = merge(initset(up) | initset(dn) | initset(lf) | initset(rt))
        PX = toobject(X, T)
        Cx = difference(palette(PX), initset(ZERO))
        C = crop(T, off, d8)
        EC = asobject(C)
        Pc = difference(palette(C), initset(ZERO))
        Cint = intersection(Cx, Pc)
        use = branch(equality(size(Cint), ZERO), Pc, Cint)
        comp = lbind(colorcount, EC)
        return argmax(use, comp)
    c00 = cross_inner_mode(z, z);   c01 = cross_inner_mode(z, t);   c02 = cross_inner_mode(z, tt)
    c10 = cross_inner_mode(t, z);   c11 = cross_inner_mode(t, t);   c12 = cross_inner_mode(t, tt)
    c20 = cross_inner_mode(tt, z);  c21 = cross_inner_mode(tt, t);  c22 = cross_inner_mode(tt, tt)
    r0 = hconcat(canvas(c00,U), hconcat(canvas(c01,U), canvas(c02,U)))
    r1 = hconcat(canvas(c10,U), hconcat(canvas(c11,U), canvas(c12,U)))
    r2 = hconcat(canvas(c20,U), hconcat(canvas(c21,U), canvas(c22,U)))
    G = vconcat(r0, vconcat(r1, r2))
    nz = difference(asindices(G), ofcolor(G, ZERO))
    O = subgrid(nz, G)
    return O
```

```python
    z = ZERO; t = TEN; tt = double(TEN); U = UNITY
    d10 = astuple(TEN, TEN)
    def border_touch_max(r0, c0):
        T = crop(I, astuple(r0, c0), d10)
        OB = objects(T, T, F, T)
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    # Geometric: per tile, choose color whose center-of-mass is closest to the inner-8x8 center
    z = ZERO; t = TEN; tt = double(TEN); U = UNITY
    d10 = astuple(TEN, TEN); off = UNITY; d8 = astuple(EIGHT, EIGHT)
    def color_nearest_center(r0, c0):
        T = crop(I, astuple(r0, c0), d10)
        C = crop(T, off, d8)
        p = astuple(FOUR, FOUR)
        Pc0 = toobject(initset(p), C)
        Pc = difference(palette(C), initset(ZERO))
        ofc = lbind(ofcolor, C)                 # c -> indices in C
        toc = rbind(toobject, C)                # S -> object in C
        ocf = compose(toc, ofc)                 # c -> object in C
        g = compose(initset, centerofmass)      # obj -> {com(obj)}
        k = compose(g, ocf)                     # c -> {com(color c in C)}
        comp = compose(lbind(manhattan, Pc0), k)
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational: classify 8s by center-of-mass axes; on V-axis->2, on H-axis (excluding V)->3, rest->1
    p = ofcolor(I, EIGHT)
    c = centerofmass(p)
    vax = vfrontier(c)
    hax = hfrontier(c)
    onv = intersection(p, vax)
    rem = difference(p, onv)
    onh = intersection(rem, hax)
    rest = difference(rem, onh)
    base = replace(I, EIGHT, ZERO)
    O = paint(paint(paint(base, recolor(ONE, rest)), recolor(THREE, onh)), recolor(TWO, onv))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    # Objectwise via center-of-mass containment in half-masks
    objs = colorfilter(objects(I, T, F, T), EIGHT)
    Tm = asindices(tophalf(I))
    Lm = asindices(lefthalf(I))
    inT = compose(lbind(contained, Tm), centerofmass)
    inL = compose(lbind(contained, Lm), centerofmass)
    tops = sfilter(objs, inT)
    lefts = sfilter(objs, inL)
    tl = intersection(tops, lefts)
    tr = difference(tops, tl)
    bl = difference(lefts, tl)
    bots = difference(objs, tops)
    br = difference(bots, bl)
    tl_r = merge(apply(lbind(recolor, FOUR), tl))
    tr_r = merge(apply(lbind(recolor, TWO), tr))
    bl_r = merge(apply(lbind(recolor, THREE), bl))
    br_r = merge(apply(lbind(recolor, ONE), br))
    base = replace(I, EIGHT, ZERO)
    O = paint(paint(paint(paint(base, tl_r), tr_r), bl_r), br_r)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    # Relational replication via shoots + frontiers with border-based orientation
    OS = objects(I, T, F, T)
    P = mapply(toindices, OS)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    top = uppermost(P)
    bot = lowermost(P)
    left = leftmost(P)
    right = rightmost(P)
    Hm1 = subtract(H, ONE)
    Wm1 = subtract(W, ONE)
    vert = both(equality(top, ZERO), equality(bot, Hm1))
    dv = subtract(bot, top)
    dh = subtract(right, left)
    o1 = first(OS)
    o2 = last(OS)
    # horizontal stripes for each seed
    l1 = first(toindices(o1))
    s1p = toivec(dv)
    s1n = toivec(invert(dv))
    L1 = combine(combine(shoot(l1, s1p), shoot(l1, s1n)), initset(l1))
    R1 = mapply(hfrontier, L1)
    H1 = recolor(color(o1), R1)
    l2 = first(toindices(o2))
    s2p = toivec(dv)
    s2n = toivec(invert(dv))
    L2 = combine(combine(shoot(l2, s2p), shoot(l2, s2n)), initset(l2))
    R2 = mapply(hfrontier, L2)
    H2 = recolor(color(o2), R2)
    HOBJ = combine(H1, H2)
    # vertical stripes for each seed
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    # Global stripes via shoots + frontiers with minimal-distance orientation (safe steps)
    OS = objects(I, T, F, T)
    P = mapply(toindices, OS)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    top = uppermost(P)
    bot = lowermost(P)
    left = leftmost(P)
    right = rightmost(P)
    dv = subtract(bot, top)
    dh = subtract(right, left)
    stepR = branch(equality(dv, ZERO), ONE, dv)
    stepC = branch(equality(dh, ZERO), ONE, dh)
    o1 = first(OS)
    o2 = last(OS)
    l1 = first(toindices(o1))
    l2 = first(toindices(o2))
    # horizontal pattern from both seeds
    L1h = combine(combine(shoot(l1, toivec(stepR)), shoot(l1, toivec(invert(stepR)))), initset(l1))
    R1 = mapply(hfrontier, L1h)
    H1 = recolor(color(o1), R1)
    L2h = combine(combine(shoot(l2, toivec(stepR)), shoot(l2, toivec(invert(stepR)))), initset(l2))
    R2 = mapply(hfrontier, L2h)
    H2 = recolor(color(o2), R2)
    HOBJ = combine(H1, H2)
    # vertical pattern from both seeds
    L1v = combine(combine(shoot(l1, tojvec(stepC)), shoot(l1, tojvec(invert(stepC)))), initset(l1))
    C1 = mapply(vfrontier, L1v)
    V1 = recolor(color(o1), C1)
    L2v = combine(combine(shoot(l2, tojvec(stepC)), shoot(l2, tojvec(invert(stepC)))), initset(l2))
    C2 = mapply(vfrontier, L2v)
    V2 = recolor(color(o2), C2)
    VOBJ = combine(V1, V2)
    # choose orientation with smaller nonzero distance
    hsel = either(equality(dh, ZERO), flip(either(equality(dv, ZERO), greater(dv, dh))))
    OOBJ = branch(hsel, HOBJ, VOBJ)
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), OOBJ)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    # Geometric orientation (min axis) + fill-based construction from frontier masks
    OS = objects(I, T, F, T)
    P = mapply(toindices, OS)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    top = uppermost(P)
    bot = lowermost(P)
    left = leftmost(P)
    right = rightmost(P)
    dv = subtract(bot, top)
    dh = subtract(right, left)
    stepR = branch(equality(dv, ZERO), ONE, dv)
    stepC = branch(equality(dh, ZERO), ONE, dh)
    o1 = first(OS)
    o2 = last(OS)
    l1 = first(toindices(o1))
    l2 = first(toindices(o2))
    # build horizontal masks and fill
    L1h = combine(combine(shoot(l1, toivec(stepR)), shoot(l1, toivec(invert(stepR)))), initset(l1))
    R1 = mapply(hfrontier, L1h)
    L2h = combine(combine(shoot(l2, toivec(stepR)), shoot(l2, toivec(invert(stepR)))), initset(l2))
    R2 = mapply(hfrontier, L2h)

    hsel = either(equality(dh, ZERO), flip(either(equality(dv, ZERO), greater(dv, dh))))
    O = branch(hsel, HF, VF)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational replication: per-seed lattice via interval offsets, merged with paint
    OS = objects(I, T, F, T)
    P = mapply(toindices, OS)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    top = uppermost(P)
    bot = lowermost(P)
    left = leftmost(P)
    right = rightmost(P)
    dv = subtract(bot, top)
    dh = subtract(right, left)
    stepR = branch(equality(dv, ZERO), ONE, dv)
    stepC = branch(equality(dh, ZERO), ONE, dh)
    o1 = first(OS)
    o2 = last(OS)
    l1 = first(toindices(o1))
    l2 = first(toindices(o2))
    # horizontal from each seed using interval offsets
    offsRpos = apply(toivec, interval(ZERO, H, stepR))
    offsR = combine(offsRpos, apply(invert, offsRpos))
    HR1 = mapply(lbind(shift, hfrontier(l1)), offsR)
    HOBJ1 = recolor(color(o1), HR1)
    HR2 = mapply(lbind(shift, hfrontier(l2)), offsR)
    HOBJ2 = recolor(color(o2), HR2)
    HOBJ = combine(HOBJ1, HOBJ2)
    # vertical from each seed using interval offsets
    offsCpos = apply(tojvec, interval(ZERO, W, stepC))
    offsC = combine(offsCpos, apply(invert, offsCpos))
    VC1 = mapply(lbind(shift, vfrontier(l1)), offsC)
    VOBJ1 = recolor(color(o1), VC1)
    VC2 = mapply(lbind(shift, vfrontier(l2)), offsC)
    VOBJ2 = recolor(color(o2), VC2)
    VOBJ = combine(VOBJ1, VOBJ2)
    hsel = either(equality(dh, ZERO), flip(either(equality(dv, ZERO), greater(dv, dh))))
    OOBJ = branch(hsel, HOBJ, VOBJ)
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), OOBJ)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl3(I):
    # Color filtering: build stripe masks per color via frontier shifts and underpaint
    OS = objects(I, T, F, T)
    c1 = color(first(OS))
    c2 = color(last(OS))
    S1 = ofcolor(I, c1)
    S2 = ofcolor(I, c2)
    l1 = first(S1)
    l2 = first(S2)
    P = combine(S1, S2)
    top = uppermost(P)
    bot = lowermost(P)
    left = leftmost(P)
    right = rightmost(P)
    dv = subtract(bot, top)
    dh = subtract(right, left)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    stepR = branch(equality(dv, ZERO), ONE, dv)
    stepC = branch(equality(dh, ZERO), ONE, dh)
    offsR = combine(apply(toivec, interval(ZERO, H, stepR)), apply(invert, apply(toivec, interval(ZERO, H, stepR))))
    offsC = combine(apply(tojvec, interval(ZERO, W, stepC)), apply(invert, apply(tojvec, interval(ZERO, W, stepC))))
    HR1 = mapply(lbind(shift, hfrontier(l1)), offsR)
    HR2 = mapply(lbind(shift, hfrontier(l2)), offsR)
    HOBJ = combine(recolor(c1, HR1), recolor(c2, HR2))
    VC1 = mapply(lbind(shift, vfrontier(l1)), offsC)
    VC2 = mapply(lbind(shift, vfrontier(l2)), offsC)
    VOBJ = combine(recolor(c1, VC1), recolor(c2, VC2))
    B = canvas(ZERO, shape(I))
    Hfilled = underpaint(underpaint(B, HOBJ), HOBJ)  # idempotent layering
    Vfilled = underpaint(underpaint(B, VOBJ), VOBJ)
    hsel = either(equality(dh, ZERO), flip(either(equality(dv, ZERO), greater(dv, dh))))
    O = branch(hsel, Hfilled, Vfilled)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational: cartesian product (seeds x offsets) shifted frontiers
    OS = objects(I, T, F, T)
    P = mapply(toindices, OS)
    top = uppermost(P)
    bot = lowermost(P)
    left = leftmost(P)
    right = rightmost(P)
    dv = subtract(bot, top)
    dh = subtract(right, left)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    stepR = branch(equality(dv, ZERO), ONE, dv)
    stepC = branch(equality(dh, ZERO), ONE, dh)
    o1 = first(OS)
    o2 = last(OS)
    c1 = color(o1)
    c2 = color(o2)
    l1 = first(toindices(o1))
    l2 = first(toindices(o2))
    BR = initset(hfrontier(l1))
    BR = insert(hfrontier(l2), BR)
    BC = initset(vfrontier(l1))
    BC = insert(vfrontier(l2), BC)
    offsR = combine(apply(toivec, interval(ZERO, H, stepR)), apply(invert, apply(toivec, interval(ZERO, H, stepR))))
    offsC = combine(apply(tojvec, interval(ZERO, W, stepC)), apply(invert, apply(tojvec, interval(ZERO, W, stepC))))
    HR = prapply(shift, BR, offsR)
    HC = prapply(shift, BC, offsC)
    # split recolor per-color by selecting base rows/cols of each seed
    HR1 = prapply(shift, initset(hfrontier(l1)), offsR)
    HR2 = prapply(shift, initset(hfrontier(l2)), offsR)
    HOBJ = combine(recolor(c1, HR1), recolor(c2, HR2))
    VC1 = prapply(shift, initset(vfrontier(l1)), offsC)
    VC2 = prapply(shift, initset(vfrontier(l2)), offsC)
    VOBJ = combine(recolor(c1, VC1), recolor(c2, VC2))
    hsel = either(equality(dh, ZERO), flip(either(equality(dv, ZERO), greater(dv, dh))))
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), branch(hsel, HOBJ, VOBJ))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational interleaving: even/odd phase offsets using base gap; avoid overlaps by staggering
    OS = objects(I, T, F, T)
    o1 = first(OS); o2 = last(OS)
    c1 = color(o1); c2 = color(o2)
    l1 = first(toindices(o1)); l2 = first(toindices(o2))
    P = combine(toindices(o1), toindices(o2))
    dv = subtract(lowermost(P), uppermost(P))
    dh = subtract(rightmost(P), leftmost(P))
    H = height(I); W = width(I)
    baseR = branch(equality(dv, ZERO), ONE, dv)
    baseC = branch(equality(dh, ZERO), ONE, dh)
    evenR = apply(toivec, interval(ZERO, H, double(baseR)))
    oddR  = mapply(lbind(add, toivec(baseR)), evenR)
    evenC = apply(tojvec, interval(ZERO, W, double(baseC)))
    oddC  = mapply(lbind(add, tojvec(baseC)), evenC)
    RL1 = recolor(c1, combine(shoot(l1, LEFT), shoot(l1, RIGHT)))
    RL2 = recolor(c2, combine(shoot(l2, LEFT), shoot(l2, RIGHT)))
    CL1 = recolor(c1, combine(shoot(l1, UP), shoot(l1, DOWN)))
    CL2 = recolor(c2, combine(shoot(l2, UP), shoot(l2, DOWN)))
    HOBJ = combine(merge(prapply(shift, initset(RL1), evenR)),
                   merge(prapply(shift, initset(RL2), oddR)))
    VOBJ = combine(merge(prapply(shift, initset(CL1), evenC)),
                   merge(prapply(shift, initset(CL2), oddC)))
    hsel = either(equality(dh, ZERO), flip(greater(dv, dh)))
    O = paint(canvas(ZERO, shape(I)), branch(hsel, HOBJ, VOBJ))
    return O
```

```python
    Pall = palette(I)
    P = remove(ZERO, Pall)
    mc = argmax(P, lbind(colorcount, I))
    cross = ofcolor(I, mc)
    c = centerofmass(cross)
    nonmc = remove(mc, P)
    colpatches = apply(lbind(ofcolor, I), nonmc)
    tocent = compose(rbind(subtract, c), centerofmass)
    quad = compose(sign, tocent)
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    colors = remove(ZERO, palette(I))
    L = argmax(colors, lbind(colorcount, I))
    marker_colors = remove(L, colors)
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    comp = fork(add, lowermost, rightmost)
    chooser = compose(rbind(argmax, comp), lbind(colorfilter, objs))
    picks = apply(chooser, marker_colors)
    pairs = product(picks, picks)
    same_row = fork(hmatching, first, last)
    distinct = compose(flip, fork(equality, first, last))
    valid = sfilter(pairs, fork(both, same_row, distinct))
    best = argmax(valid, fork(manhattan, first, last))
    endpoints = apply(centerofmass, totuple(best))
    seg = connect(first(endpoints), last(endpoints))
    base = replace(I, L, ZERO)
    O = underfill(base, L, seg)
    return O
```

```python
    markers = merge(colorfilter(objects(I, T, F, T), remove(L, colors)))
    bbox = backdrop(markers)
    ones = ofcolor(I, ONE)
    twos = ofcolor(I, TWO)
    bag = insert(twos, initset(ones))
    tips = merge(bag)
    pathfunc = compose(lbind(intersection, bbox), vfrontier)
    vsegs = merge(apply(pathfunc, tips))
    base = replace(I, L, ZERO)
    O = underfill(base, L, vsegs)
    return O
```

```python
    colors = remove(ZERO, palette(I))
    L = argmax(colors, lbind(colorcount, I))
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    nonL = colorfilter(objs, remove(L, colors))

    best = argmax(valid, fork(manhattan, first, last))
    endpoints = apply(centerofmass, totuple(best))
    seg = connect(first(endpoints), last(endpoints))
    base = replace(I, L, ZERO)
    O = underfill(base, L, seg)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    # Geometric: gravitate merged non-dominant mass toward dominant mass and outline its new position
    colors = remove(ZERO, palette(I))
    L = argmax(colors, lbind(colorcount, I))
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    Lobjs = sfilter(objs, matcher(color, L))
    nonL = sfilter(objs, compose(flip, matcher(color, L)))
    mL = merge(Lobjs)
    mN = merge(nonL)
    dir = gravitate(mN, mL)
    moved = shift(mN, dir)
    edge = outbox(moved)
    base = replace(I, L, ZERO)
    O = underfill(base, L, edge)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational: fill the negative space (bounding-box minus content) around merged non-dominant mass
    colors = remove(ZERO, palette(I))
    L = argmax(colors, lbind(colorcount, I))
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    nonL = sfilter(objs, compose(flip, matcher(color, L)))
    mN = merge(nonL)
    hollow = delta(mN)
    base = replace(I, L, ZERO)
    O = underfill(base, L, hollow)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    dims = shape(I)
    H = height(I)
    Z = canvas(ZERO, dims)
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)

    const0 = lbind(identity, ZERO)
    startloc = fork(astuple, uppermost, const0)
    rowpatch = compose(rbind(shoot, RIGHT), startloc)
    rowobj = fork(recolor, color, rowpatch)
    rowobjs = mapply(rowobj, objs)

    topobj = argmin(objs, uppermost)
    botobj = argmax(objs, lowermost)
    toprow = recolor(color(topobj), shoot(astuple(ZERO, ZERO), RIGHT))
    H1 = decrement(H)
    botrow = recolor(color(botobj), shoot(astuple(H1, ZERO), RIGHT))

    unionrows = combine(rowobjs, combine(toprow, botrow))
    O = paint(Z, unionrows)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl2(I):
    dims = shape(I)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    Z = canvas(ZERO, dims)
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)

    const0 = lbind(identity, ZERO)
    W1 = decrement(W)
    constw1 = lbind(identity, W1)

    # full row at object row
    startloc = fork(astuple, uppermost, const0)
    rowpatch = compose(rbind(shoot, RIGHT), startloc)
    rowobj = fork(recolor, color, rowpatch)

    # small vertical segments (r-1 to r+1) on both borders
    dec_r = compose(decrement, uppermost)
    inc_r = compose(increment, uppermost)

    left_top = fork(astuple, dec_r, const0)
    left_bot = fork(astuple, inc_r, const0)
    left_seg = fork(connect, left_top, left_bot)
    left_obj = fork(recolor, color, left_seg)

    right_top = fork(astuple, dec_r, constw1)
    right_bot = fork(astuple, inc_r, constw1)
    right_seg = fork(connect, right_top, right_bot)
    right_obj = fork(recolor, color, right_seg)

    sides = fork(combine, left_obj, right_obj)
    triplet = fork(combine, rowobj, sides)
    segs = mapply(triplet, objs)

    # also enforce edge rows colored by top/bottom objects
    topobj = argmin(objs, uppermost)
    botobj = argmax(objs, lowermost)
    toprow = recolor(color(topobj), shoot(astuple(ZERO, ZERO), RIGHT))
    H1 = decrement(H)
    botrow = recolor(color(botobj), shoot(astuple(H1, ZERO), RIGHT))

    allobjs = combine(segs, combine(toprow, botrow))
    O = paint(Z, allobjs)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    dims = shape(I)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    Z = canvas(ZERO, dims)
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)

    # horizontal full rows at anchors (object rows)
    const0 = lbind(identity, ZERO)
    startloc = fork(astuple, uppermost, const0)
    rowpatch = compose(rbind(shoot, RIGHT), startloc)
    rowobj = fork(recolor, color, rowpatch)
    rowobjs = mapply(rowobj, objs)

    # also include top and bottom edge rows colored by top/bottom objects
    topobj = argmin(objs, uppermost)
    botobj = argmax(objs, lowermost)
    toprow = recolor(color(topobj), shoot(astuple(ZERO, ZERO), RIGHT))
    H1 = decrement(H)
    botrow = recolor(color(botobj), shoot(astuple(H1, ZERO), RIGHT))

    # build vertical border segments split at midpoints between consecutive anchors
    pairs = product(objs, objs)
    ra = compose(uppermost, first)
    rb = compose(uppermost, last)
    ca = compose(color, first)
    cb = compose(color, last)
    cond = fork(greater, rb, ra)  # keep pairs with rb > ra
    ordpairs = sfilter(pairs, cond)

    W1 = decrement(W)
    constw1 = lbind(identity, W1)
    midf = compose(halve, fork(add, ra, rb))

    # left column segments
    a_left = fork(astuple, ra, const0)
    m_left = fork(astuple, midf, const0)
    b_left = fork(astuple, rb, const0)
    top2mid_l = fork(connect, a_left, m_left)
    mid2bot_l = fork(connect, compose(increment, midf), b_left)
    top2mid_l_obj = fork(recolor, ca, top2mid_l)
    mid2bot_l_obj = fork(recolor, cb, mid2bot_l)
    left_union = fork(combine, top2mid_l_obj, mid2bot_l_obj)

    # right column segments
    a_right = fork(astuple, ra, constw1)
    m_right = fork(astuple, midf, constw1)
    b_right = fork(astuple, rb, constw1)
    top2mid_r = fork(connect, a_right, m_right)
    mid2bot_r = fork(connect, compose(increment, midf), b_right)
    top2mid_r_obj = fork(recolor, ca, top2mid_r)
    mid2bot_r_obj = fork(recolor, cb, mid2bot_r)
    right_union = fork(combine, top2mid_r_obj, mid2bot_r_obj)

    pair_union = fork(combine, left_union, right_union)
    border_objs = mapply(pair_union, ordpairs)

    allobjs = combine(border_objs, combine(rowobjs, combine(toprow, botrow)))
    O = paint(Z, allobjs)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    dims = shape(I)
    H = height(I)
    Z = canvas(ZERO, dims)
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)

    idxs = asindices(I)
    jL = leftmost(idxs)
    jR = rightmost(idxs)
    vL = tojvec(jL)
    vR = tojvec(jR)

    # full rows at anchors
    rvec = compose(toivec, uppermost)
    pL = compose(lbind(add, vL), rvec)
    pR = compose(lbind(add, vR), rvec)
    rowline = fork(connect, pL, pR)
    rowobj = fork(recolor, color, rowline)
    rowobjs = mapply(rowobj, objs)

    # consecutive pairs of anchors
    ords = order(objs, uppermost)
    headless = remove(last(ords), ords)
    tailless = remove(first(ords), ords)
    pairs = pair(headless, tailless)

    ra = compose(uppermost, first)
    rb = compose(uppermost, last)
    ca = compose(color, first)
    cb = compose(color, last)
    mid = compose(halve, fork(add, ra, rb))

    aL = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, ra))
    mL = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, mid))
    bL = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, rb))
    aR = compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, ra))
    mR = compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, mid))
    bR = compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, rb))

    top2midL = fork(connect, aL, mL)
    mid2botL = fork(connect, compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, compose(increment, mid))), bL)
    top2midR = fork(connect, aR, mR)
    mid2botR = fork(connect, compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, compose(increment, mid))), bR)

    segL = fork(combine, fork(recolor, ca, top2midL), fork(recolor, cb, mid2botL))
    segR = fork(combine, fork(recolor, ca, top2midR), fork(recolor, cb, mid2botR))
    segPair = fork(combine, segL, segR)
    borders = mapply(segPair, pairs)

    # top and bottom edge rows by extremes
    topobj = argmin(objs, uppermost)
    botobj = argmax(objs, lowermost)
    topL = astuple(ZERO, jL)
    topR = astuple(ZERO, jR)
    H1 = decrement(H)
    botL = astuple(H1, jL)
    botR = astuple(H1, jR)
    toprow = recolor(color(topobj), connect(topL, topR))
    botrow = recolor(color(botobj), connect(botL, botR))

    allobjs = combine(borders, combine(rowobjs, combine(toprow, botrow)))
    O = paint(Z, allobjs)
    return O
```

```python
    BR = astuple(decrement(H), jR)

    cb = compose(color, last)

    aR = compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, ra))
    bL = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, rb))
    bR = compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, rb))
    mL = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, mid))
    mR = compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, mid))
    mL1 = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, mid1))
    mR1 = compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, mid1))

    rectUp = compose(backdrop, fork(combine, fork(connect, aL, mR), fork(connect, aR, mL)))
    rectDn = compose(backdrop, fork(combine, fork(connect, mL1, bR), fork(connect, mR1, bL)))
    outUp = compose(box, rectUp)
    outDn = compose(box, rectDn)
    lUp = fork(recolor, ca, compose(lbind(intersection, leftcol), outUp))
    rUp = fork(recolor, ca, compose(lbind(intersection, rightcol), outUp))
    lDn = fork(recolor, cb, compose(lbind(intersection, leftcol), outDn))
    rDn = fork(recolor, cb, compose(lbind(intersection, rightcol), outDn))
    frames = mapply(fork(combine, fork(combine, lUp, rUp), fork(combine, lDn, rDn)), pairs)

    rvec = compose(toivec, uppermost)
    pL = compose(lbind(add, vL), rvec)
    pR = compose(lbind(add, vR), rvec)
    rowseg = fork(connect, pL, pR)
    rows = mapply(fork(recolor, color, rowseg), ords)

    botobj = last(ords)
```

```python
    tailless = remove(first(ords), ords)

    ra = compose(uppermost, first)
    rb = compose(uppermost, last)
    ca = compose(color, first)

    mid = compose(halve, fork(add, ra, rb))

    bL = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, rb))
    bR = compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, rb))
    mL = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, mid))
    mR = compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, mid))
    mL1 = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, mid1))

    rows = mapply(fork(recolor, color, fork(connect, pL, pR)), ords)
```

```python
    TL = astuple(ZERO, jL)
    TR = astuple(ZERO, jR)
    BL = astuple(decrement(H), jL)
    BR = astuple(decrement(H), jR)
    leftcol = connect(TL, BL)
    rightcol = connect(TR, BR)

    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    ords = order(objs, uppermost)
    headless = remove(last(ords), ords)
    tailless = remove(first(ords), ords)
    pairs = pair(headless, tailless)

    ra = compose(uppermost, first)
    rb = compose(uppermost, last)
    ca = compose(color, first)
    cb = compose(color, last)
    mid = compose(halve, fork(add, ra, rb))
    mid1 = compose(increment, mid)

    aL = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, ra))
    aR = compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, ra))
    bL = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, rb))
    bR = compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, rb))
    mL = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, mid))
    mR = compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, mid))
    mL1 = compose(lbind(add, vL), compose(toivec, mid1))
    mR1 = compose(lbind(add, vR), compose(toivec, mid1))

    segLUpRect = compose(backdrop, fork(connect, aL, mL))
    segRUpRect = compose(backdrop, fork(connect, aR, mR))
    segLDnRect = compose(backdrop, fork(connect, mL1, bL))
    segRDnRect = compose(backdrop, fork(connect, mR1, bR))

    lUp = fork(recolor, ca, compose(lbind(intersection, leftcol), segLUpRect))
    rUp = fork(recolor, ca, compose(lbind(intersection, rightcol), segRUpRect))
    lDn = fork(recolor, cb, compose(lbind(intersection, leftcol), segLDnRect))
    rDn = fork(recolor, cb, compose(lbind(intersection, rightcol), segRDnRect))
    pillars = mapply(fork(combine, fork(combine, lUp, rUp), fork(combine, lDn, rDn)), pairs)

    rvec = compose(toivec, uppermost)
    pL = compose(lbind(add, vL), rvec)
    pR = compose(lbind(add, vR), rvec)
    rows = mapply(fork(recolor, color, fork(connect, pL, pR)), ords)

    topobj = first(ords)
    botobj = last(ords)
    topc = color(topobj)
    botc = color(botobj)

    tLseg = recolor(topc, intersection(leftcol, backdrop(connect(TL, pL(topobj)))))
    tRseg = recolor(topc, intersection(rightcol, backdrop(connect(TR, pR(topobj)))))
    bLseg = recolor(botc, intersection(leftcol, backdrop(connect(pL(botobj), BL))))

    topfull = recolor(topc, connect(TL, TR))
    botfull = recolor(botc, connect(BL, BR))

    O = paint(Z, combine(rows, combine(pillars, combine(tLseg, combine(tRseg, combine(bLseg, combine(bRseg, combine(topfull, botfull))))))))
    return O
```

```python
    base = cover(I, pix)
    p2obj = compose(rbind(toobject, I), compose(initset, identity))
    mbuilder = compose(lbind(rbind, manhattan), p2obj)
    F = compose(rbind(compose, box), mbuilder)
    nearest_seed_box = chain(lbind(argmin, seeds), F, identity)
    pred_builder = lbind(matcher, nearest_seed_box)
    assigned = chain(lbind(sfilter, pix), pred_builder, identity)
    assigned_obj = compose(rbind(toobject, I), compose(merge, assigned))
    recol_for_seed = fork(recolor, compose(color, identity), assigned_obj)
    recolored = apply(recol_for_seed, seeds)
    O = paint(base, merge(recolored))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    pix8 = ofcolor(I, EIGHT)
    base = cover(I, pix8)
    # seed template (3x3) at its own UL, stamped onto each 3x3 eight-tile occurrence by aligning UL corners
    ul8 = ulcorner(pix8)
    tile8 = asobject(crop(I, ul8, THREE_BY_THREE))
    # seed patch 3x3 around the UL of non-8s
    non8pix = difference(asindices(I), pix8)
    ulseed = ulcorner(non8pix)
    seedtile_grid = crop(I, ulseed, THREE_BY_THREE)
    seedtile = asobject(seedtile_grid)
    occs = occurrences(I, tile8)
    place8 = compose(lbind(shift, tile8), identity)
    dirf = compose(rbind(subtract, ulseed), compose(ulcorner, place8))
    const_seedtile = lbind(identity, seedtile)
    placed_seedtile = fork(shift, const_seedtile, dirf)
    # restrict to eight region and paint
    placed_in_8 = compose(rbind(toobject, I), compose(lbind(intersection, pix8), compose(toindices, placed_seedtile)))
    recolored = apply(placed_in_8, occs)
    O = paint(base, merge(recolored))
    return O
```

```python
    DIR0 = initset(UNITY)
    DIR1 = insert(NEG_UNITY, DIR0)
    DIR2 = insert(UP_RIGHT, DIR1)
    DIR = insert(DOWN_LEFT, DIR2)
    COLORS = remove(ZERO, palette(I))
    SFN = lbind(ofcolor, I)
    R0 = lbind(prapply, shoot)
    R1 = rbind(R0, DIR)
    PFN = compose(merge, R1)
    STARTS = compose(PFN, SFN)
    COLORIZE = fork(recolor, identity, STARTS)
    PARTS = apply(COLORIZE, COLORS)
    OBJ = merge(PARTS)
    Z = canvas(ZERO, shape(I))
    O = paint(Z, OBJ)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl2(I):
    OB = objects(I, T, F, T)
    SC = leastcolor(I)
    SO = colorfilter(OB, SC)
    HL = mfilter(SO, hline)
    VL = mfilter(SO, vline)
    BH = argmax(HL, size)
    BV = argmax(VL, size)
    HC = size(occurrences(I, BH))
    VC = size(occurrences(I, BV))
    HD = add(HC, ONE)
    WD = add(VC, ONE)
    D = astuple(HD, WD)
    BG = mostcolor(I)
    O = canvas(BG, D)
```

```python
    BG = mostcolor(I)
    H = height(I)
    W = width(I)
    S = ofcolor(I, SC)
    s = colorcount(I, SC)
    L0 = first(asindices(I))
    HR = hfrontier(L0)
    C = size(intersection(S, HR))
    CH = multiply(C, H)
    N = subtract(s, CH)
    Dn = subtract(W, C)
    R = divide(N, Dn)
    HD = add(R, ONE)
    WD = add(C, ONE)
    D = astuple(HD, WD)
    O = canvas(BG, D)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    A = ofcolor(I, TWO)
    B = ofcolor(I, FIVE)
    hr = rightmost(A)
    hl = leftmost(A)
    br = rightmost(B)
    bl = leftmost(B)
    at = uppermost(A)
    ab = lowermost(A)
    bt = uppermost(B)
    bb = lowermost(B)
    condR = greater(bl, hr)
    condL = greater(hl, br)
    moveR = subtract(subtract(bl, hr), ONE)
    moveL = add(subtract(br, hl), ONE)
    hvec = branch(condR, tojvec(moveR), branch(condL, tojvec(moveL), ORIGIN))
    condD = greater(bt, ab)
    condU = greater(at, bb)
    downVal = subtract(subtract(bt, ab), ONE)
    upVal = add(subtract(bb, at), ONE)
    vvec = branch(condD, toivec(downVal), branch(condU, toivec(upVal), ORIGIN))
    d = add(hvec, vvec)
    base = replace(I, TWO, SEVEN)
    O = fill(base, TWO, shift(A, d))
    return O
```

```python
    n = divide(height(I), k)
```

```python
    Offs = apply(lbind(multiply, vec), steps)
    Tiles = prapply(shift, Anchored, Offs)
    U = merge(Tiles)
    O = underpaint(I, U)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    NZ = difference(asindices(I), ofcolor(I, ZERO))
    JL = leftmost(NZ)
    JR = rightmost(NZ)
    JM = divide(add(JL, JR), TWO)
    def col_triplet(j):
        COL = intersection(NZ, vfrontier(astuple(ZERO, j)))
        U = branch(positive(size(COL)), uppermost(COL), NEG_ONE)
        L = branch(positive(size(COL)), lowermost(COL), NEG_ONE)
        M = branch(positive(size(COL)), divide(add(uppermost(COL), lowermost(COL)), TWO), NEG_ONE)
        CT = branch(greater(U, NEG_ONE), index(I, astuple(U, j)), ZERO)
        CM = branch(greater(M, NEG_ONE), index(I, astuple(M, j)), ZERO)
        CB = branch(greater(L, NEG_ONE), index(I, astuple(L, j)), ZERO)
        return vconcat(vconcat(canvas(CT, UNITY), canvas(CM, UNITY)), canvas(CB, UNITY))
    C1 = col_triplet(JL)
    C2 = col_triplet(JM)
    C3 = col_triplet(JR)
    O = hconcat(hconcat(C1, C2), C3)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    W = width(I)
    NZ = difference(asindices(I), ofcolor(I, ZERO))
    U = uppermost(NZ)
    L = lowermost(NZ)
    M = divide(add(U, L), TWO)
    def row_first3_of_rowidx(i):
        R = crop(I, astuple(i, ZERO), astuple(ONE, W))
        NZr = difference(asindices(R), ofcolor(R, ZERO))
        WD = width(R)
        W1 = increment(WD)
        W2 = increment(W1)
        S0 = initset(astuple(ZERO, WD))
        S1 = insert(astuple(ZERO, W1), S0)
        S2 = insert(astuple(ZERO, W2), S1)
        P1 = combine(NZr, S2)
        J1 = leftmost(P1)
        NZ2 = difference(NZr, intersection(NZr, vfrontier(astuple(ZERO, J1))))
        P2 = combine(NZ2, S2)
        J2 = leftmost(P2)
        NZ3 = difference(NZ2, intersection(NZ2, vfrontier(astuple(ZERO, J2))))
        P3 = combine(NZ3, S2)
        J3 = leftmost(P3)
        C1 = branch(greater(WD, J1), index(R, astuple(ZERO, J1)), ZERO)
        C2 = branch(greater(WD, J2), index(R, astuple(ZERO, J2)), ZERO)
        C3 = branch(greater(WD, J3), index(R, astuple(ZERO, J3)), ZERO)
        return hconcat(hconcat(canvas(C1, UNITY), canvas(C2, UNITY)), canvas(C3, UNITY))
    O = vconcat(vconcat(row_first3_of_rowidx(U), row_first3_of_rowidx(M)), row_first3_of_rowidx(L))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    Os = objects(I, T, F, T)
    S = argmin(Os, size)
    c = color(S)
    U = argmin(Os, uppermost)
    D = argmax(Os, lowermost)
    L = argmin(Os, leftmost)
    R = argmax(Os, rightmost)
    V = connect(center(U), center(D))
    H = connect(center(L), center(R))
    P = combine(V, H)
    O = underfill(I, c, P)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    five = ofcolor(I, FIVE)
    c = corners(five)
    miss = first(difference(c, five))
    tl = ulcorner(five)
    tr = urcorner(five)
    bl = llcorner(five)
    br = lrcorner(five)
    cond = both(contained(tl, five), contained(br, five))
    diag = branch(cond, connect(tl, br), connect(tr, bl))
    pbox = box(five)
    rowedge = intersection(hfrontier(miss), pbox)
    coledge = intersection(vfrontier(miss), pbox)
    borders = combine(rowedge, coledge)
    patch = combine(diag, borders)
    O = underfill(I, EIGHT, patch)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    sqs = sfilter(objs, square)
    # use shoot outward then restrict to outbox to keep only the first step
    ul = ulcorner
    ur = urcorner
    ll = llcorner
    lr = lrcorner
    s_up_ul = compose(lbind(shoot, UP), ul)
    s_left_ul = compose(lbind(shoot, LEFT), ul)
    s_up_ur = compose(lbind(shoot, UP), ur)
    s_right_ur = compose(lbind(shoot, RIGHT), ur)
    s_down_ll = compose(lbind(shoot, DOWN), ll)
    s_left_ll = compose(lbind(shoot, LEFT), ll)
    s_down_lr = compose(lbind(shoot, DOWN), lr)
    s_right_lr = compose(lbind(shoot, RIGHT), lr)
    a = fork(combine, s_up_ul, s_left_ul)
    b = fork(combine, s_up_ur, s_right_ur)
    c = fork(combine, s_down_ll, s_left_ll)
    d = fork(combine, s_down_lr, s_right_lr)
    ab = fork(combine, a, b)
    cd = fork(combine, c, d)
    allshoot = fork(combine, ab, cd)
    ext = fork(intersection, allshoot, outbox)
    fR = compose(lbind(recolor, TWO), ext)
    obj2 = mapply(fR, sqs)
    O = paint(I, obj2)
    return O
```

```python
    axes = combine(vline, hline)
    mask = intersection(p5, axes)
    base = replace(I, FIVE, EIGHT)
    O = fill(base, TWO, mask)
    return O
```

```python
    hasL = intersection(p5, shift(p5, LEFT))
    hasR = intersection(p5, shift(p5, RIGHT))
    hasU = intersection(p5, shift(p5, UP))
```

```python
    noH = difference(vbridge, combine(hasL, hasR))
    mask = combine(noV, noH)
    base = replace(I, FIVE, EIGHT)
    O = fill(base, TWO, mask)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    # Object extraction by shape matching with a least-color exemplar
    val = leastcolor(I)
    parts = colorfilter(fgpartition(I), val)
    exemplar = argmax(parts, size)
    dims = shape(toindices(exemplar))
    onesobjs = colorfilter(fgpartition(I), ONE)
    getdims = compose(shape, toindices)
    eqdims = lbind(equality, dims)
    matches = sfilter(onesobjs, compose(eqdims, getdims))
    target = merge(apply(toindices, matches))
    O = fill(I, val, target)
    return O
```

```python
    c = leastcolor(I)
```

```python
    LU = intersection(L, U)
    LD = intersection(L, D)
    RU = intersection(R, U)

    B2 = combine(combine(LU, LD), combine(RU, RD))
```

```python
    Nall = combine(Ntip, Nbend)
    G = fill(I, FOUR, E)
    O = fill(G, TWO, Nall)
    return O
```

```python
    OB = objects(I, T, F, T)

    BOT = argmax(BOR, lowermost)
    cT = color(TOP)
    cB = color(BOT)
```

```python
    BO = colorfilter(OB, cB)
```

```python
    Bnon = difference(BO, Bbor)
    UL = compose(ulcorner, inbox)
    RL = compose(hfrontier, UL)
    TI = compose(inbox, identity)
    TopEdge = fork(intersection, RL, TI)
    BLL = compose(llcorner, inbox)
    BRL = compose(hfrontier, BLL)
    BotEdge = fork(intersection, BRL, TI)

    Hm2 = subtract(H, TWO)

    SB = fork(shift, identity, vecB)

    Bmov = apply(SB, Bedge)

    return O
```

```python
    pAll = asindices(I)
    pOther = difference(pAll, pTB)
    O = underpaint(O0, toobject(pOther, I))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational + reconstruction: align non-border objects to inner-adjacent rows; keep only those rows; restore others
    OB = objects(I, T, F, T)
    BOR = sfilter(OB, rbind(bordering, I))
    TOP = argmin(BOR, uppermost)
    BOT = argmax(BOR, lowermost)
    cT = color(TOP)
    cB = color(BOT)
    TO = colorfilter(OB, cT)
    BO = colorfilter(OB, cB)
    Tbor = sfilter(TO, rbind(bordering, I))
    Bbor = sfilter(BO, rbind(bordering, I))
    Tnon = difference(TO, Tbor)
    Bnon = difference(BO, Bbor)
    H = height(I)
    Hm2 = subtract(H, TWO)
    drT = compose(lbind(subtract, ONE), uppermost)
    vecT = compose(toivec, drT)
    drB = compose(lbind(subtract, Hm2), lowermost)
    vecB = compose(toivec, drB)
    ST = fork(shift, identity, vecT)
    SB = fork(shift, identity, vecB)
    Tmov = apply(ST, Tnon)
    Bmov = apply(SB, Bnon)
    R1 = hfrontier(astuple(ONE, ZERO))
    Hm1 = subtract(H, ONE)
    Rb = hfrontier(astuple(Hm1, ZERO))
    Rm2 = hfrontier(astuple(Hm2, ZERO))
    Pt = intersection(toindices(merge(Tmov)), R1)
    Pb = intersection(toindices(merge(Bmov)), Rm2)
    BG = mostcolor(I)
    C = canvas(BG, shape(I))
    O0 = fill(fill(C, cT, Pt), cB, Pb)
    O1 = paint(paint(O0, TOP), BOT)
    pT = ofcolor(I, cT)
    pB = ofcolor(I, cB)
    S = initset(pT)
    S2 = insert(pB, S)
    pTB = merge(S2)
    pAll = asindices(I)
    pOther = difference(pAll, pTB)
    O = underpaint(O1, toobject(pOther, I))
    return O
```

```python
    condB = compose(positive, compose(size, compose(rbind(intersection, FB), toindices)))
```

```python
    BB = apply(box, BO)
```

```python
def dsl2(I):
    # Object extraction and sliding: gravitate interior objects in each half to their border; recolor; redraw borders
    BG = mostcolor(I)
    H = height(I)
    Half = halve(H)
    TT = interval(ZERO, Half, ONE)
    TB = interval(Half, H, ONE)
    FT = merge(mapply(hfrontier, apply(toivec, TT)))
    FB = merge(mapply(hfrontier, apply(toivec, TB)))
    OB = objects(I, T, F, T)
    BOR = sfilter(OB, rbind(bordering, I))
    TopB = argmin(BOR, uppermost)
    BotB = argmax(BOR, lowermost)
    cT = color(TopB)
    cB = color(BotB)
    R0 = hfrontier(astuple(ZERO, ZERO))
    Rb = hfrontier(astuple(subtract(H, ONE), ZERO))
    INOB = sfilter(OB, compose(flip, rbind(bordering, I)))
    condT = compose(positive, compose(size, compose(rbind(intersection, FT), toindices)))
    condB = compose(positive, compose(size, compose(rbind(intersection, FB), toindices)))
    TO = sfilter(INOB, condT)
    BO = sfilter(INOB, condB)
    TOI = apply(toindices, TO)
    BOI = apply(toindices, BO)

    Bdir = apply(rbind(gravitate, BotB), BOI)

    Bshifts = mpapply(shift, BOI, Bdir)
    Tmask = difference(merge(Tshifts), R0)
    Bmask = difference(merge(Bshifts), Rb)
    C = canvas(BG, shape(I))
    O0 = fill(C, cT, Tmask)
    O1 = fill(O0, cB, Bmask)
    O2 = fill(O1, cT, R0)
    O = fill(O2, cB, Rb)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational/propagation: initialize top segments, then propagate colors downward via repeated underpaint of shifted objects
    idx = asindices(I)
    nz = difference(idx, ofcolor(I, ZERO))
    toobj = rbind(toobject, I)
    getc = compose(color, compose(toobj, initset))
    vcol = vfrontier
    topcol = compose(ulcorner, vcol)
    colnz = compose(lbind(intersection, nz), vcol)
    topnz = compose(ulcorner, colnz)
    seg_up = fork(connect, topcol, topnz)
    col_topc = compose(getc, topnz)
    obj_up = fork(recolor, col_topc, seg_up)
    topobjs = merge(apply(obj_up, nz))
    G0 = underpaint(I, topobjs)
    # Define one downward-propagation step on a grid
    idxf = asindices
    zerof = rbind(ofcolor, ZERO)
    nzindsf = fork(difference, idxf, zerof)
    nzobjf = fork(toobject, nzindsf, identity)
    shiftd = rbind(shift, DOWN)
    objdownf = compose(shiftd, nzobjf)
    step = fork(underpaint, identity, objdownf)
    relax = power(step, 30)
    O = relax(G0)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    idx = asindices(I)
    at = compose(rbind(index, I), identity)
    shR = compose(rbind(add, RIGHT), identity)
    shD = compose(rbind(add, DOWN), identity)
    shL = compose(rbind(add, LEFT), identity)
    shU = compose(rbind(add, UP), identity)
    valR = compose(at, shR)
    valD = compose(at, shD)
    valL = compose(at, shL)
    valU = compose(at, shU)
    eq8 = rbind(equality, EIGHT)
    eq0 = rbind(equality, ZERO)
    c_here = compose(eq8, at)
    c_r = compose(eq8, valR)
    c_d = compose(eq8, valD)
    c_l0 = compose(eq0, valL)
    c_u0 = compose(eq0, valU)
    c1 = fork(both, c_here, c_r)
    c2 = fork(both, c_d, c_l0)
    c3 = fork(both, c1, c2)
    cond = fork(both, c3, c_u0)
    uls = sfilter(idx, cond)
    seedpos = compose(rbind(add, NEG_UNITY), identity)
    seedcol = compose(rbind(index, I), seedpos)
    nz = compose(flip, compose(eq0, seedcol))
    sel = sfilter(uls, nz)
    dims = double(TWO_BY_TWO)
    off = decrement(dims)
    lrcalc = compose(rbind(add, off), identity)
    cset = fork(combine, compose(initset, identity), compose(initset, lrcalc))
    rect = compose(backdrop, cset)
    diamond = fork(difference, rect, compose(corners, rect))
    recol = apply(fork(recolor, seedcol, diamond), sel)
    obj = merge(recol)
    spatches = apply(compose(initset, seedpos), sel)
    spatch = merge(spatches)
    base = fill(I, ZERO, spatch)
    O = paint(base, obj)
    return O
```

```python
    Up = intersection(shoot(UR, UP), Ext)
    Dn = intersection(shoot(UR, DOWN), Ext)
    Lt = intersection(shoot(UR, LEFT), Ext)
    Rt = intersection(shoot(UR, RIGHT), Ext)

    D = astuple(Di, Dj)
    G = replace(I, SIX, NINE)
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    # Global (compress) with dominant-axis step via manhattan
    Ic = compress(I)
    P5c = ofcolor(Ic, FIVE)
    Bc = inbox(P5c)
    Extc = difference(combine(ofcolor(Ic, NINE), ofcolor(Ic, SIX)), Bc)
    URc = urcorner(Bc)
    Di0c = sign(subtract(uppermost(Extc), uppermost(Bc)))
    Dj0c = sign(subtract(leftmost(Extc), rightmost(Bc)))
    Hc = astuple(ZERO, Dj0c)
    Vc = astuple(Di0c, ZERO)
    PHc = initset(add(URc, Hc))
    PVc = initset(add(URc, Vc))
    dHc = manhattan(PHc, Extc)
    dVc = manhattan(PVc, Extc)
    D = branch(greater(dVc, dHc), Hc, branch(greater(dHc, dVc), Vc, astuple(Di0c, Dj0c)))
    P5 = ofcolor(I, FIVE)
    B = inbox(P5)
    J = intersection(ofcolor(I, NINE), B)
    G = replace(I, SIX, NINE)
    O = fill(fill(G, FIVE, J), NINE, shift(J, D))
    return O
```

```python
    nHD = invert(HD)

    P0 = combine(shift(S, HD), shift(S, nHD))
```

```python
    P3 = combine(shift(S, add(HD, nVD)), shift(S, add(nHD, nVD)))
    P = intersection(INT, combine(combine(P0, P1), combine(P2, P3)))
    O = underfill(I, TWO, P)
    return O
```

```python
    # Local midpoint bridging: fill cells centered between symmetric 2s (axis and diagonals) inside interiors
    EO = colorfilter(objects(I, T, F, T), EIGHT)
    IN = merge(mapply(inbox, EO))
    BO = merge(mapply(box, EO))

    S = intersection(ofcolor(I, TWO), INT)
    L = shift(S, LEFT)
    R = shift(S, RIGHT)
    U = shift(S, UP)
    D = shift(S, DOWN)
    Hmid = intersection(L, R)
    Vmid = intersection(U, D)
    ULdir = add(UP, LEFT)
    URdir = add(UP, RIGHT)
    DLdir = add(DOWN, LEFT)
    DRdir = add(DOWN, RIGHT)
    ULs = shift(S, ULdir)
    URs = shift(S, URdir)
    DLs = shift(S, DLdir)
    DRs = shift(S, DRdir)
    D1 = intersection(ULs, DRs)
    D2 = intersection(URs, DLs)
    P = intersection(INT, combine(combine(Hmid, Vmid), combine(D1, D2)))
    O = underfill(I, TWO, P)
    return O
```

```python
    # Object extraction via nearest-to-corners (manhattan)
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    m = ofcolor(I, TWO)
    ul = ulcorner(m)
    ur = urcorner(m)
    ll = llcorner(m)
    lr = lrcorner(m)
    toPatch = toindices
    distUL = compose(rbind(manhattan, initset(ul)), toPatch)
```

```python
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Quadrant partition using COM-based predicates (both/flip), then localized selection
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    com = centerofmass(ofcolor(I, TWO))
    ci = first(com)
    cj = last(com)
    topPred = compose(lbind(greater, ci), uppermost)
    botPred = compose(flip, topPred)
    leftPred = compose(lbind(greater, cj), leftmost)
    rightPred = compose(flip, leftPred)
    TLpred = fork(both, topPred, leftPred)
    TRpred = fork(both, topPred, rightPred)
    BLpred = fork(both, botPred, leftPred)
    BRpred = fork(both, botPred, rightPred)
    TLset = sfilter(objs, TLpred)
    TRset = sfilter(objs, TRpred)
    BLset = sfilter(objs, BLpred)
    BRset = sfilter(objs, BRpred)
    sumUL = fork(add, uppermost, leftmost)
    negR = compose(invert, rightmost)
    sumUR = fork(add, uppermost, negR)
    negB = compose(invert, lowermost)
    sumBL = fork(add, negB, leftmost)
    sumBR = fork(add, negB, negR)
    TL = argmin(TLset, sumUL)
    TR = argmin(TRset, sumUR)
    BL = argmin(BLset, sumBL)
    BR = argmin(BRset, sumBR)
    gtl = subgrid(TL, I)

    gbl = subgrid(BL, I)
    gbr = subgrid(BR, I)
    zcol = canvas(ZERO, astuple(3, 1))

    bot7 = hconcat(hconcat(gbl, zcol), gbr)
    z13 = canvas(ZERO, astuple(1, 3))
```

```python
    dims = shape(I)
    blank = canvas(ZERO, dims)
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    cols = remove(ZERO, palette(I))
    percolor = apply(lbind(colorfilter, objs), cols)
    anchors = apply(rbind(argmax, size), percolor)
    pairs = pair(percolor, anchors)
    def per_pair(pc_a):
        cobjs = first(pc_a)
        anch = last(pc_a)
        ai = toindices(anch)
        ob = outbox(ai)
        extras = remove(anch, cobjs)
        exisets = apply(toindices, extras)
        exis = merge(exisets)
        colsel = compose(lbind(intersection, ai), vfrontier)
        rowsel = compose(lbind(intersection, ai), hfrontier)
        sel = branch(hline(anch), colsel, rowsel)
        acells_sets = apply(sel, exis)
        acells = apply(first, acells_sets)
        pr = pair(exis, acells)
        paths = apply(fork(connect, first, last), pr)
        hits = apply(lbind(intersection, ob), paths)
        dests = merge(hits)
        moved = recolor(color(anch), dests)
        return combine(anch, moved)
    parts = apply(per_pair, pairs)
    O = paint(blank, merge(parts))
    return O
```

```python
    dims = shape(I)
    blank = canvas(ZERO, dims)
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
```
```python
    isline = fork(either, hline, vline)
```
```python
    lines = sfilter(objs, isline)
```

```python
        c = color(l)
        ai = toindices(l)
        cobjs = colorfilter(objs, c)
        extras = remove(l, cobjs)
        ei = merge(apply(toindices, extras))
        vmask = merge(apply(vfrontier, ei))
        hmask = merge(apply(hfrontier, ei))
        sides_h = combine(shift(ai, UP), shift(ai, DOWN))
        sides_v = combine(shift(ai, LEFT), shift(ai, RIGHT))
        tgt_h = intersection(sides_h, vmask)
        tgt_v = intersection(sides_v, hmask)
        tgt = branch(hline(l), tgt_h, tgt_v)
        recol = recolor(c, tgt)
        return combine(l, recol)
    parts = apply(per_line, lines)
    O = paint(blank, merge(parts))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
```
```python
    P = asindices(I)
    ones = ofcolor(I, ONE)
    sixes = ofcolor(I, SIX)
    base = replace(I, SIX, EIGHT)
    def per(o):
        p = initset(o)
        predh = compose(lbind(hmatching, p), initset)
        predv = compose(lbind(vmatching, p), initset)
        cond = fork(either, predh, predv)
        aligned = sfilter(sixes, cond)
        comp = compose(lbind(manhattan, p), initset)
        q = valmin(aligned, comp)
        qq = initset(q)
        d = gravitate(p, qq)
        orth = branch(equality(d, UP), LEFT, branch(equality(d, DOWN), RIGHT, branch(equality(d, LEFT), DOWN, UP)))
        dist = manhattan(p, qq)
        off = multiply(orth, dist)
        t = add(o, off)
        return intersection(initset(t), P)
    T = merge(apply(per, ones))
    O = fill(base, SEVEN, T)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl2(I):
    P = asindices(I)
    base = replace(I, SIX, EIGHT)
    ones = ofcolor(I, ONE)
    sixes = ofcolor(I, SIX)
    rayU = rbind(shoot, UP)
    rayD = rbind(shoot, DOWN)
    rayL = rbind(shoot, LEFT)
    rayR = rbind(shoot, RIGHT)
    def per(o):
        p = initset(o)
        cU = intersection(rayU(o), sixes)
        cD = intersection(rayD(o), sixes)
        cL = intersection(rayL(o), sixes)
        cR = intersection(rayR(o), sixes)
        cand = combine(combine(cU, cD), combine(cL, cR))
        comp = compose(lbind(manhattan, p), initset)
        q = argmin(cand, comp)
        dirv = sign(subtract(q, o))
        orth = branch(equality(dirv, UP), LEFT, branch(equality(dirv, DOWN), RIGHT, branch(equality(dirv, LEFT), DOWN, UP)))
        qq = initset(q)
        dist = manhattan(p, qq)
        t = add(o, multiply(orth, dist))
        return intersection(initset(t), P)
    T = merge(apply(per, ones))
    O = fill(base, SEVEN, T)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl3(I):
    P = asindices(I)
    base = replace(I, SIX, EIGHT)
    ones = ofcolor(I, ONE)
    sixes = ofcolor(I, SIX)
    def per(o):
        p = initset(o)
        predh = compose(lbind(hmatching, p), initset)
        predv = compose(lbind(vmatching, p), initset)
        cond = fork(either, predh, predv)
        aligned = sfilter(sixes, cond)
        comp = compose(lbind(manhattan, p), initset)
        q = argmin(aligned, comp)
        dirv = sign(subtract(q, o))
        orth = branch(equality(dirv, UP), LEFT, branch(equality(dirv, DOWN), RIGHT, branch(equality(dirv, LEFT), DOWN, UP)))
        dist = manhattan(p, initset(q))
        t = add(o, multiply(orth, dist))
        return intersection(initset(t), P)
    T = merge(apply(per, ones))
    O = fill(base, SEVEN, T)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    S = asindices(I)
    idx = lbind(index, I)
    ofc = lbind(ofcolor, I)
    cp = compose(ofc, idx)
    row = hfrontier
    col = vfrontier
    inter_row = fork(intersection, cp, row)
    inter_col = fork(intersection, cp, col)
    sz_row = compose(size, inter_row)
    sz_col = compose(size, inter_col)
    eqw = rbind(equality, width(I))
    eqh = rbind(equality, height(I))
    isrow = compose(eqw, sz_row)
    iscol = compose(eqh, sz_col)
    cond = fork(either, isrow, iscol)
    loc = extract(S, cond)
    c = index(I, loc)
    O = canvas(c, UNITY)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    ALL = asindices(I)
    ul = ulcorner(ALL)
    ur = urcorner(ALL)
    ll = llcorner(ALL)
    lr = lrcorner(ALL)
    leftE = connect(ul, ll)
    rightE = connect(ur, lr)
    topE = connect(ul, ur)
    botE = connect(ll, lr)
    OB = objects(I, T, F, T)
    vmL = rbind(vmatching, leftE)
    vmR = rbind(vmatching, rightE)
    hmT = rbind(hmatching, topE)
    hmB = rbind(hmatching, botE)
    touches_lr = fork(both, vmL, vmR)
    touches_tb = fork(both, hmT, hmB)
    cond = fork(either, touches_lr, touches_tb)
    obj = extract(OB, cond)
    c = color(obj)
    O = canvas(c, UNITY)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Interior from the dominant border color's border-touching union
    objs = objects(I, T, F, T)
    borderobjs = sfilter(objs, rbind(bordering, I))
    cols = remove(ZERO, palette(I))
    cf = lbind(colorfilter, objs)
    ib = lbind(intersection, borderobjs)
    mrg = compose(merge, ib)
    dsz = chain(size, delta, mrg)
    comp = compose(dsz, cf)
    bc = valmax(cols, comp)
    sel = intersection(borderobjs, colorfilter(objs, bc))
    bd = merge(sel)
    inner = delta(bd)
    O = subgrid(inner, I)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    # Relational: intersection of backdrops of the two most common nonzero colors
    colors = remove(ZERO, palette(I))
    mc = argmax(colors, lbind(colorcount, I))
    rest = remove(mc, colors)
    sc = argmax(rest, lbind(colorcount, I))
    p1 = backdrop(ofcolor(I, mc))
    p2 = backdrop(ofcolor(I, sc))
    inter = intersection(p1, p2)
    O = subgrid(inter, I)
    return O
```

```python
    lj = leftmost(P)

    keepR = intersection(S, R)
    base = replace(I, FIVE, TWO)
    O = paint(paint(base, toobject(keepL, I)), toobject(keepR, I))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    zeros8 = replace(I, ZERO, EIGHT)
    z1 = replace(zeros8, ONE, ZERO)
    z2 = replace(z1, NINE, ZERO)
    mirrored = vmirror(z2)
    both = cellwise(z2, mirrored, ZERO)
    axis = ofcolor(I, ONE)
    L1 = shift(axis, LEFT)
    L2 = shift(axis, multiply(LEFT, TWO))
    L3 = shift(axis, multiply(LEFT, THREE))
    leftarea = combine(L1, combine(L2, L3))
    O = crop(both, ulcorner(leftarea), astuple(height(I), THREE))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl2(I):
    axis = ofcolor(I, ONE)
    Z = ofcolor(I, ZERO)
    L1 = shift(axis, LEFT)
    L2 = shift(axis, multiply(LEFT, TWO))
    L3 = shift(axis, multiply(LEFT, THREE))
    R1 = shift(axis, RIGHT)
    R2 = shift(axis, multiply(RIGHT, TWO))
    R3 = shift(axis, multiply(RIGHT, THREE))
    lz1 = intersection(Z, L1)
    lz2 = intersection(Z, L2)
    lz3 = intersection(Z, L3)
    rz1 = intersection(Z, R1)
    rz2 = intersection(Z, R2)
    rz3 = intersection(Z, R3)
    b1 = intersection(lz1, shift(rz1, multiply(LEFT, TWO)))
    b2 = intersection(lz2, shift(rz2, multiply(LEFT, FOUR)))
    b3 = intersection(lz3, shift(rz3, multiply(LEFT, SIX)))
    both = combine(b1, combine(b2, b3))
    base = canvas(ZERO, shape(I))
    painted = fill(base, EIGHT, both)
    leftarea = combine(L1, combine(L2, L3))
    O = crop(painted, ulcorner(leftarea), astuple(height(I), THREE))
    return O
```

```python
def dsl3(I):
    axis = ofcolor(I, ONE)
    L1 = shift(axis, LEFT)
    L2 = shift(axis, multiply(LEFT, TWO))
    L3 = shift(axis, multiply(LEFT, THREE))
    R1 = shift(axis, RIGHT)
    R2 = shift(axis, multiply(RIGHT, TWO))
    R3 = shift(axis, multiply(RIGHT, THREE))
    leftarea = combine(L1, combine(L2, L3))
    rightarea = combine(R1, combine(R2, R3))
    dims = astuple(height(I), THREE)
    L = crop(I, ulcorner(leftarea), dims)
    R = crop(I, ulcorner(rightarea), dims)
    Ls = switch(L, ZERO, EIGHT)
    Lr1 = replace(Ls, ONE, ZERO)
    Lz = replace(Lr1, NINE, ZERO)
    Rs = switch(R, ZERO, EIGHT)
    Rr1 = replace(Rs, ONE, ZERO)
    Rz = replace(Rr1, NINE, ZERO)
    Rrev = rot180(hmirror(rot180(Rz)))
    O = cellwise(Lz, Rrev, ZERO)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    axis = ofcolor(I, ONE)
    L1 = shift(axis, LEFT)
    L2 = shift(axis, multiply(LEFT, TWO))
    L3 = shift(axis, multiply(LEFT, THREE))
    R1 = shift(axis, RIGHT)
    R2 = shift(axis, multiply(RIGHT, TWO))
    R3 = shift(axis, multiply(RIGHT, THREE))
    leftarea = combine(L1, combine(L2, L3))
    rightarea = combine(R1, combine(R2, R3))
    dims = astuple(height(I), THREE)
    L = crop(I, ulcorner(leftarea), dims)
    R = crop(I, ulcorner(rightarea), dims)
    Ls = replace(replace(replace(L, ZERO, EIGHT), ONE, ZERO), NINE, ZERO)
    Rs = replace(replace(replace(R, ZERO, EIGHT), ONE, ZERO), NINE, ZERO)
    Rrev = rot180(hmirror(rot180(Rs)))
    Lpatch = ofcolor(Ls, EIGHT)
    Rpatch = ofcolor(Rrev, EIGHT)
    overlap = intersection(Lpatch, Rpatch)
    O = fill(canvas(ZERO, dims), EIGHT, overlap)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl1(I):
    zeros8 = replace(I, ZERO, EIGHT)
    z1 = replace(zeros8, ONE, ZERO)
    z2 = replace(z1, NINE, ZERO)
    mir = vmirror(z2)
    both = cellwise(z2, mir, ZERO)
    axis = ofcolor(I, ONE)
    L1 = shift(axis, LEFT)
    L2 = shift(axis, multiply(LEFT, TWO))
    L3 = shift(axis, multiply(LEFT, THREE))
    leftarea = combine(L1, combine(L2, L3))
    dims = astuple(height(I), THREE)
    BL = crop(both, ulcorner(leftarea), dims)
    R1 = shift(axis, RIGHT)
    R2 = shift(axis, multiply(RIGHT, TWO))
    R3 = shift(axis, multiply(RIGHT, THREE))
    rightarea = combine(R1, combine(R2, R3))
    RG = crop(z2, ulcorner(rightarea), dims)
    cols = hsplit(RG, THREE)
    c3 = last(cols)
    Pboth = ofcolor(BL, EIGHT)
    Pc3 = ofcolor(c3, EIGHT)
    Pc3s = shift(Pc3, multiply(RIGHT, TWO))
    P = combine(Pboth, Pc3s)
    O = fill(canvas(ZERO, dims), EIGHT, P)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl5(I):
    axis = ofcolor(I, ONE)
    Z = ofcolor(I, ZERO)
    N = ofcolor(I, NINE)
    R1 = shift(axis, RIGHT)
    R2 = shift(axis, multiply(RIGHT, TWO))
    R3 = shift(axis, multiply(RIGHT, THREE))
    rz1 = intersection(Z, R1)
    rz2 = intersection(Z, R2)
    rz3 = intersection(Z, R3)
    M1 = shift(rz1, multiply(LEFT, TWO))
    M2 = shift(rz2, multiply(LEFT, FOUR))
    M3 = shift(rz3, multiply(LEFT, SIX))
    Mall = combine(M1, combine(M2, M3))
    L1 = shift(axis, LEFT)
    rows_nine = intersection(N, L1)
    sup2 = shift(rows_nine, LEFT)
    sup3 = shift(rows_nine, multiply(LEFT, TWO))
    Supp = combine(sup2, sup3)
    P = difference(Mall, Supp)
    base = canvas(ZERO, shape(I))
    painted = fill(base, EIGHT, P)
    L2 = shift(axis, multiply(LEFT, TWO))
    L3 = shift(axis, multiply(LEFT, THREE))
    leftarea = combine(L1, combine(L2, L3))
    dims = astuple(height(I), THREE)
    O = crop(painted, ulcorner(leftarea), dims)
    return O
```

```python
def dsl4(I):
    # Geometric: gravitate all foreground toward central cross (both axes)
    J = replace(I, FIVE, FOUR)
    allidx = asindices(J)
    fg = difference(allidx, ofcolor(J, FOUR))
    c = center(allidx)
    vln = combine(shoot(c, UP), shoot(c, DOWN))
    hln = combine(shoot(c, LEFT), shoot(c, RIGHT))
    cross = combine(vln, hln)
    d = gravitate(fg, cross)
    O = move(canvas(FOUR, shape(J)), toobject(fg, J), d)
    return O
```
